newsitem.title: UK: European vegetable oil prices ease towards close.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oil prices ease towards close.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices eased towards the close on Wednesday following the lower opening in Chicago
Chicago soy futures fell on reports that demand for soymeal in China had collapsed and Chinese ports were clogged with up to one million tonnes.
Traders said the European market had been sidelined for most of the day despite active palm oil trading in the Far East which pushed palm oil prices higher.
"Our prices followed the Malaysian markets, but in the end there was no local demand," said a trader.
At the closed crude palm oil cif Europe was $5 up with no further business reported.
Products were also quiet with sellers $2.50 to $5 up.
Coconut oil also finished $2.50 to $5 up with business confined mostly to switching.
Dec/Jan traded at $797.50 in a switch with Jan/Feb at $790 a tonne.
Feb/Mar also traded in a switch with Mar/Apr at a $12.50 spread.
Palmkernel oil closed unchanged to $2.50 down.
Soft oils closed with soy oil 0.50 guilders up to one guilder down and rape oil one to 0.50 guilders higher.
